Game Overview

In Crowd Evolution!, the core idea is straightforward: guide a burgeoning crowd through the ages, evolving from cavemen to futuristic pioneers. Navigate through intriguing evolutionary gates, making strategic choices to expand your army and secure triumph. Experience the thrill of shaping human history while leading your vibrant assembly to victory. Dive into an exhilarating journey through time!
